_about: Swing breakout rules for the Nifty 100 watchlist (breakouts.py). Change a number here to change when you get an alert. Set an optional rule to null (or false) to switch it off.
_level_choices: resistance = top of the nearest resistance zone (the Breakout level on your charts); high20 / high60 = highest high of the last 20 / 60 sessions; high52w = 52-week high
_min_close_in_range: 0.5 = price must be in the top half of the day's range (no long upper wick)
_min_rs_vs_nifty_pct: 3-month return minus the Nifty 50's; 0 = must be beating the market
_max_base_depth_pct: e.g. 12 = only breakouts from a tight 15-day base (high-to-low range under 12% of the level)
_require_market_uptrend: true = no alerts while the Nifty 50 is below its 50-day EMA (otherwise the alert just warns)
